prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Workout Tracker sport mastery avatar. Generate exactly ONE fictional male Netball athlete for the Diamond tier. Polished premium semi-realistic stylised 3D game-skin illustration, credible for ages 10 through adult; crisp face, natural athletic proportions, well-defined hands and believable equipment. Original character, not a real athlete or celebrity. Character identity: medium olive skin, short dark wavy hair, brown eyes. Experienced adult, approximately 26–30; mature face and composed leadership expression, not a copied junior face. Collection palette: white and cobalt junior kit; cobalt/navy with warm gold details. This tier's outfit below determines the current colours. Outfit: Championship-quality navy/cobalt kit with restrained gold trim. Equipment: One netball, netball court shoes, practical court kit. Male wears jersey/shorts; female wears a practical netball dress or jersey/shorts with equal quality. A small blank position patch may be present; no generated lettering. Award: Tall national-league-style cup. Pose: Age29 experienced adult face calm direct leadership gaze, grounded shoulder-width front captain stance, ONE white/cobalt netball tucked arm, opposite hand on hip. Championship NAVY/COBALT kit restrained gold trim practical shoes blank position patch no lettering. ONE tall NATIONAL LEAGUE CUP gold/silver conventional two-handled crowned trophy dark tall base beside feet. No extra award or medal. Entire head hands shoes ball cup alpha margins visible. Tier silhouette direction: Composed leadership stance, broader grounded base and a calm direct expression; distinguish it from the action and walking silhouettes. Square portrait. Entire head, hands, equipment and both feet visible, centred with 6–8% clear transparent margins. Athlete occupies roughly 80–88% of canvas height; trophies fit naturally inside the frame. Keep face and torso unobstructed. Match the rendering finish and proportions of the supplied style reference, but follow this tier's kit and award brief. Keep the corresponding male and female tier equal in prestige, award scale, kit quality and visual presence. Create a real transparent background with clean alpha edges. No words, lettering, numbers, brand or team logos, watermark, border, background scene, extra people, unrelated weapons, fantasy armour, wings, magic, neon aura or trophy clutter. Bronze has no award. Do not invent extra medals or accessories. No copied official trophy inscriptions. Preserve recognisable eye shape, skin tone and hair character, while visibly ageing the same fictional person. Do not preserve the junior face proportions in adult tiers. Mature facial structure, natural eye-to-face proportions, a developed nose/jaw and less rounded cheeks must make Platinum onward unmistakably adult in BOTH appearances; do not rely on muscles, makeup, a beard, suit or trophies to signal age. Styling stays polished and semi-realistic, with no oversized doll eyes or baby-faced adult. Pose references supply equipment/kit only: do not duplicate their stance, hand placement, body angle or expression across tiers. The sport is this individual's story, not a demographic stereotype or a restriction that this person can only play one sport.

Sport-specific constraints: Male and female avatars are equally available even where familiar elite competitions differ by category. Use generic open netball competition honours for both, rather than assigning the male version a women-only official event.

References establish own identity and adult endpoint; male counterpart kit/awards only. Do not copy youthful anatomy. Follow the NEW tier pose specified here.
review: Agent visually inspected: mature face, kit, captain stance, correct title cup, full framing. Workspace disconnected before dimensions/hash/alpha validation and pair checkpoint; validate on recovery.
